about.label: // OVERVIEW
about.title: About G.T.I.
about.subtitle: Global Terrorism Intervention — A global anti-terrorism rapid response force operating independently from the UN peacekeeping system

global.title: Global Deployment
global.text: Multiple divisions worldwide, including North America, Asia, Oceania, and Africa. Operators from member nations can rapidly respond to terrorism threats in any region globally.

legal.title: Legal Authorization
legal.text: Officially established by UN Security Council resolution, maintaining high autonomy in personnel, budget, and operational command, with legal authorization to take all necessary measures to maintain regional stability.

elite.title: Elite Operators
elite.text: The core special forces were initially drawn from the US Delta Force, then gradually recruited elite special operations forces from around the world through the member nation dispatch system, forming a world-class special operations force.

mission.title: Core Mission
mission.text: Contain the Havoc Group's threat to global security, contest and control the Mandel Bricks, prevent Havoc's secret experiments, disrupt the "Babel Tower Plan", and dismantle their space military operations.

history.label: // HISTORY
history.title: History
history.subtitle: From the Mogadishu Tragedy to the Birth of G.T.I.

1993.title: The Mogadishu Tragedy
1993.description: US Delta Force suffered a major failure in Somalia's "Gothic Serpent" operation. The "Black Hawk Down" incident exposed the international community's institutional deficiencies in responding to regional crises, becoming the spiritual origin of GTI's establishment.

1993-2018.title: Prolonged International Consultations
1993-2018.description: Following the Somalia crisis, the international community spent twenty-five years discussing and designing institutions for a rapidly deployable, legally authorized global anti-terrorism force with top-tier combat capabilities.

2018.title: G.T.I. Officially Established
2018.description: By UN Security Council resolution, the Global Terrorism Intervention was officially established. The organization operates independently from the existing UN peacekeeping system, maintaining high autonomy in personnel, budget, and operational command.

2032.title: Intervention in Ahsarah Region
2032.description: Due to the deteriorating situation in the Ahsarah region, the UN Security Council authorized G.T.I. to deploy in the area and take all necessary measures to maintain regional stability. This marked GTI's transition from theory to full-scale operational deployment.

2035.title: Full-Scale Confrontation with Havoc
2035.description: GTI dispatched elite operators deep into Ahsarah to fully investigate the Havoc Group's illegal activities. Operations "Diamond Hotel", "Ascender", and "Echo" were launched in succession, bringing the full-scale confrontation with the Havoc Group to a fever pitch.

resolution.label: // AUTHORIZATION
resolution.title: Security Council Authorization Resolution
resolution.docTitle:
Resolution on Authorizing the Global Terrorism Intervention (G.T.I.)
to Deploy in the Ahsarah Region and Take All Necessary Measures
to Maintain Regional Stability

preamble.recallsText: its previous resolutions and presidential statements on the situation in the Ahsarah region,
preamble.reaffirmsText: its firm commitment to the sovereignty, independence, unity and territorial integrity of the Republic of Ahsarah,
preamble.concernedText: by the serious threat posed by the increasingly rampant military activities of the Havoc Group in the region to international peace and security,
preamble.notingText: that the "Mandel Brick" high-value military computing modules developed and deployed by the Havoc Group could alter the regional military balance,
preamble.condemningText: all forms of terrorist acts by the Havoc Group and the casualties they have caused to civilians,
preamble.emphasizingText: the need to deploy an international anti-terrorism force with rapid response capability and legal authorization in the Ahsarah region,
preamble.determiningText: that the situation in the Ahsarah region constitutes a threat to international peace and security,
preamble.actingText: under Chapter VII of the Charter of the United Nations,

items.text: the Global Terrorism Intervention (G.T.I.), as a global anti-terrorism rapid response force operating independently from the existing UN peacekeeping system, to deploy in the Ahsarah region to carry out missions to maintain regional stability;
G.T.I. to take all necessary measures in the Ahsarah region, including but not limited to the use of force, to contain the Havoc Group's terrorist activities and military expansion;
that the Havoc Group immediately cease all terrorist activities, secret experiments, and military deployments, including but not limited to the "Babel Tower Plan" and its space military operations;
all member states to fully cooperate with G.T.I., providing necessary facilities for its deployment and operations, including transit permits, logistical support, and intelligence sharing;
that G.T.I.'s operational budget shall be shared proportionally by all member states, included in the UN peacekeeping budget framework, and subject to nominal budget management;
that the G.T.I. Standing Committee has full decision-making authority over organizational operations, and the Security Council shall not intervene in real-time in its specific operations;
G.T.I. to regularly submit operational reports to the Security Council and a comprehensive assessment upon mission completion;
to remain actively seized of the matter.

honglang.name: Kai Silva
honglang.bio: GTI front-line operations captain, exoskeleton assault core

profile.background: Red Wolf was born in a conflict zone and endured the ravages of war throughout his childhood. His father, Karl Huston, a decorated veteran of Delta Force, adopted the infant Kai in 2007 during an operation. When Red Wolf was twelve, his father was killed in action. Driven by his father's creed of "protection", Red Wolf enlisted and, in 2024, passed the Delta Force selection as the youngest candidate in the unit's history.
profile.desertSpring: In 2034, during Operation "Desert Spring" in North Africa, Red Wolf disobeyed a strict cease-fire order to rescue a trapped young girl, sustaining severe injuries to both legs in the process.
profile.joingti: The injury would have ended most military careers, but G.T.I. Commander Dominic Santiago recognized his exceptional combat instincts and field judgment. Red Wolf was recruited into G.T.I. and became the first operational user of the organization's powered exoskeleton system.
profile.skillsIntro: Red Wolf's combat kit is built around his powered exoskeleton, emphasizing extreme mobility and breakthrough capability.

equipment.name: Tactical Equipment: Powered Exoskeleton
equipment.desc: Activated via a wrist-mounted controller, the exoskeleton temporarily boosts movement speed, rate of fire, and slide distance. Eliminating enemies restores health and extends the overload duration.

active.name: Active Skill: Triple Grenade Launcher
active.desc: Fires three high-explosive grenades with an effective range of approximately 80 meters, dealing area-of-effect damage with fracture and concussive effects. Grenades ricochet off obstacles and adhere to vehicles.

throwable.name: Throwable: Tactical Smoke Grenade
throwable.desc: Deploys a rapid-expansion smoke screen lasting approximately 8 seconds, used to cover advances or retreats.

passive.name: Passive Skill: Tactical Slide
passive.desc: Triggered by crouching while sprinting. This is the core of Red Wolf's high-mobility combat style, enabling rapid repositioning, fire evasion, and close-quarters engagement.

profile.playstyle: Flanker and battlefield harvester. Red Wolf uses superior mobility to flank or encircle enemy positions, disrupting formations and isolated targets.
profile.engagement: Engagement sequence: suppress at range with the grenade launcher → activate exoskeleton for a high-speed advance → close the gap with tactical slide to secure eliminations.
profile.weapons: Recommended weapons: SMGs (e.g., MP5) and shotguns, complementing his close-range, high-tempo combat style.

weilong.name: Yuhao Wang
weilong.bio: Former carrier-based aircraft pilot, mobile assault core

profile.background: Yuhao Wang demonstrated exceptional spatial awareness and physical coordination from an early age. Selected as a youth for the Naval Aviation Academy, he completed carrier landing qualifications with the highest scores in his cohort, becoming one of the youngest carrier-based fighter pilots in the service. Years of high-intensity carrier operations forged extraordinary equilibrium, G-force tolerance, and split-second reaction speed.
profile.desertSpring: During a night carrier landing exercise, a catastrophic hydraulic failure rendered Wang's arresting hook completely inoperative. Drawing on extraordinary airmanship, he executed a manual emergency recovery under extreme conditions, preserving both the aircraft and his own life. The incident drew the attention of G.T.I.'s Technical Assessment Division.
profile.joingti: When G.T.I. initiated its Individual Kinetic Assist System — the jet pack program — the organization urgently required a test pilot possessing superior high-altitude adaptability and extreme G-force endurance. Wang's distinguished flight record and physiological profile made him the prime candidate, and he was formally transferred to the G.T.I. Asia Division. After rigorous ground and aerial acclimatization training, he became the first operator to achieve operational deployment with the jet pack system, integrating aircraft control principles into ground-level high-speed maneuver warfare and establishing a new paradigm in assault tactics.
profile.skillsIntro: Wyvern's combat framework is built around the Individual Kinetic Assist System, emphasizing three-dimensional high-speed mobility and vertical strike capability.

equipment.name: Tactical Equipment: Kinetic Assist System
equipment.desc: A back-mounted jet propulsion unit capable of delivering powerful horizontal or vertical thrust in short bursts, enabling high-speed advances, aerial hovering, and rapid repositioning. An integrated stabilization module maintains firing accuracy during high-speed maneuvers.

active.name: Active Skill: Crouching Tiger Cannon
active.desc: Fires a high-pressure compressed air projectile that generates a powerful shockwave on impact, displacing enemy personnel and inducing momentary loss of balance. Effective for breaking through defensive lines, flushing targets from cover, or disrupting enemy formations.

throwable.name: Throwable: Magnetic Sticky Bomb
throwable.desc: A directional demolition charge equipped with a strong magnetic adhesion module. Upon throwing, it firmly attaches to any metallic surface or vehicle and detonates after a timed delay. Suited for anti-vehicle operations, area denial, and precision target elimination.

passive.name: Passive Skill: Rapid Displacement
passive.desc: The passive effect of the Kinetic Assist System significantly reduces fall damage during high-speed movement while enhancing base movement speed. This trait grants Wyvern superior mobility efficiency across complex terrain compared to standard operators.

profile.playstyle: High-speed breakthrough specialist and vertical assault core. Wyvern leverages the jet pack to penetrate via unconventional vectors, striking from angles the enemy does not anticipate, excelling at disrupting defensive lines and rapidly withdrawing to regroup.
profile.engagement: Engagement sequence: close the distance rapidly or seize elevated positions using the jet pack → disrupt enemy formations with the Crouching Tiger Cannon → eliminate priority targets with Magnetic Sticky Bombs → disengage at high speed.
profile.weapons: Recommended weapons: assault rifles (e.g., M4A1) and SMGs, balancing mid- to close-range engagements to complement his high-tempo assault-and-contact fighting rhythm.

profile.background: Lena van der Meer was born into a family of physicians in Europe and displayed a natural aptitude for biomedical science from childhood. She earned her doctorate in Nano-Bioengineering with distinction; her doctoral thesis, "Clinical Viability of Nano-Scale Targeted Repair Systems", garnered widespread academic attention. Upon graduation, she was recruited by the Havoc Group's Biotechnology Division to lead research and development in nano-medical repair technology, becoming the youngest core project director in the field.
profile.desertSpring: During her tenure at Havoc, Lena gradually discovered that her research had been covertly repurposed for military applications — nano-technology was being weaponized into battlefield enhancement serums rather than the civilian medical treatments she had envisioned. When she attempted to expose the truth, she was placed under house arrest and surveillance by Havoc Group. Exploiting an internal security lapse, she escaped with core research data and was nearly eliminated by a Havoc kill squad during extraction. She was ultimately rescued by a G.T.I. Europe Division special operations team.
profile.joingti: G.T.I. accorded the highest priority to the nano-medical technology Lena carried. In recognition of her exceptional expertise and invaluable insight into Havoc's internal operations, G.T.I. formally granted her operator status under the codename "Butterfly" — a symbol of metamorphosis and rebirth. She redirected her nano-technology toward battlefield medical aid, developing the Butterfly Drone tactical rescue system that has become an irreplaceable pillar of G.T.I.'s support framework.
profile.skillsIntro: Butterfly's combat framework is built around nano-medical technology and autonomous drone platforms, emphasizing sustained battlefield rescue and team survivability.

equipment.name: Tactical Equipment: Butterfly Rescue Drone Swarm
equipment.desc: Deploys a swarm of butterfly-shaped autonomous rescue drones that fly to downed teammates and execute remote revivals automatically. The drones can absorb one explosion during the rescue process, ensuring the revival is not interrupted. Holding the ability button directs the drones to heal the operator herself.

active.name: Active Skill: Nano-Medical Dust
active.desc: Launches a cloud of nano-medical particles that adhere to a teammate or the operator, continuously restoring health. The healing rate exceeds that of standard medical devices and persists even while the target is mobile, making it ideal for sustaining allies during intense firefights.

throwable.name: Throwable: Remote-Controlled Fog
throwable.desc: Upon deployment, generates a dense smoke barrier whose landing point and dispersal direction can be manually adjusted via remote control. Offers superior controllability and precision compared to conventional smoke grenades, useful for covering rescues, obstructing enemy sightlines, or creating tactical decoys.

passive.name: Passive Skill: Vital Signs Detection
passive.desc: Automatically monitors the vital signs of all teammates within a defined radius. When a teammate's health drops to a critical threshold, the system provides real-time alerting. This passive capability enables Butterfly to intervene before teammates are downed, achieving preventive medical response.

profile.playstyle: Positional support anchor and team sustain specialist. Butterfly's core value lies in maintaining the entire squad's combat endurance — through remote drone revivals and continuous nano-dust healing, she keeps the team operational through prolonged, high-intensity engagements.
profile.engagement: Engagement sequence: anticipate teammate contact vectors and pre-deploy smoke → sustain frontline allies with Nano-Medical Dust → execute remote revives via drone for downed teammates → reposition proactively based on Vital Signs Detection alerts.
profile.weapons: Recommended weapons: SMGs (e.g., UMP45) and sidearms, emphasizing self-defense capability consistent with her rear-line support role and avoidance of direct firefights.

profile.background: Zoya Ponchenkova was born in Saint Petersburg into a family with a deep military tradition; all three of her elder brothers served on the front lines. As a youth, Zoya was rebellious and outspoken, dreaming of forming a rock band with her brothers and harboring no interest in a military career. The cruelty of war, however, shattered that dream utterly — her eldest brother was killed in action, and the other two sustained severe injuries. This family tragedy compelled her to devote herself to neurochemical research, determined to use science to protect the lives of frontline soldiers.
profile.desertSpring: Zoya's breakthrough成果 in neurostimulant technology earned her a direct commission into the SSO Special Forces. During a high-intensity engagement, she personally tested a self-developed adrenaline activation device, successfully enabling her squad to break through an enemy encirclement before ammunition was exhausted. The operation cemented her reputation within the military research establishment. However, her ideological rift with a former research partner — now the head of Havoc Group's Relink brain-computer interface project — widened steadily, ultimately driving them into opposing camps.
profile.joingti: After evaluating Zoya's neurostimulant technology, G.T.I. determined it held irreplaceable strategic value in the battlefield support domain. Zoya formally joined the G.T.I. Eastern Europe Division under the codename "Venom." She fused neurochemistry with drone technology to develop the Firefly Swarm System, capable of penetrating cover to disrupt enemy perception and reduce their maximum health, while simultaneously boosting allied combat effectiveness through adrenaline activation devices — establishing herself as a uniquely versatile composite operator within G.T.I.'s support framework.
profile.skillsIntro: Venom's combat framework is built around neurochemical technology and drone swarms, emphasizing suppression of enemy perception and amplification of allied combat capability.

equipment.name: Tactical Equipment: Firefly Swarm System
equipment.desc: Deploys a swarm of micro-drones that penetrate cover to disrupt the perception systems of enemy personnel along their path, blurring their vision and reducing maximum health. Simultaneously briefly activates the adrenaline of friendly personnel along the route, enhancing weapon handling speed and reaction time.

active.name: Active Skill: Adrenaline Activation
active.desc: Deploys an adrenaline activation device that provides sustained weapon handling buffs to nearby friendly personnel, significantly improving firing stability and reload speed. Most effective during the firepower suppression phase of high-intensity engagements.

throwable.name: Throwable: Blinding Toxic Fog
throwable.desc: Upon deployment, releases a large-area blinding toxic fog that creates a visual obscuration zone. Enemy personnel entering the fog suffer severely limited vision and sustained disruption. Useful for blocking passages, covering retreats, or coordinating breach operations.

passive.name: Passive Skill: Battlefield Medical Optimization
passive.desc: Reduces healing time on teammates and shortens injury recovery intervals, enabling Venom to maintain squad-wide health more efficiently during sustained operations and enhancing overall team endurance.

profile.playstyle: Battlefield tempo controller and offensive-defensive amplifier. Venom weakens enemy combat power through Firefly drones while reinforcing allied output with adrenaline devices, holding decisive advantage in wars of attrition and positional warfare.
profile.engagement: Engagement sequence: Firefly drones penetrate cover to weaken enemies → Blinding Toxic Fog obstructs enemy sightlines → Adrenaline Activation boosts teammate firepower → continuous healing sustains frontline pressure.
profile.weapons: Recommended weapons: assault rifles and SMGs, balancing mid-range engagement with self-defense, consistent with her rear-line support and battlefield tempo control role.

fengyi.name: Roy Smee
fengyi.bio: Combat medic core, team sustain specialist

profile.background: Roy Smee grew up in an impoverished neighborhood in North America, running with street gangs as a youth and earning a reputation for reckless defiance. A brutal street brawl in which he watched a young man bleed out from lack of medical attention became his turning point. He resolved to change his life, gaining admission to medical school through sheer determination and specializing in battlefield emergency medicine. After graduation, he joined Doctors Without Borders, accumulating extensive field medical experience across multiple conflict zones.
profile.desertSpring: During a humanitarian relief mission in an African conflict zone, Roy's medical team came under武装 attack by militants. Under fire, he held a position alone behind cover, using hormone injectors to administer emergency treatment to seven critically wounded personnel — all of whom survived. The incident was formally documented by the military, and G.T.I. flagged his extraordinary record when screening battlefield medical talent.
profile.joingti: As one of the earliest support operators recruited by G.T.I., Roy became an indispensable core member through his extensive combat medical experience and calm field judgment. His codename "Medic" evokes the tireless守护 of a worker bee守护 its hive. Combining traditional battlefield急救 with Honeycomb technology, he developed the Smoke Drone and Hormone Gun systems, capable of completing a rapid revival of a downed teammate in 1.4 seconds — establishing himself as the founding pillar of G.T.I.'s support framework.
profile.skillsIntro: Medic's combat framework is built around高效 battlefield急救 and smoke obscuration, emphasizing rapid rescue and team survivability.

profile.engagement: Engagement sequence: anticipate teammate contact vectors and pre-deploy Smoke Drone → Hormone Gun远程 sustains frontline teammate health → rapid revive of downed队友 → Honeycomb Smoke Grenade分割 battlefield to cover retreat.

muyangren.name: Terry Musa
muyangren.bio: Former police EOD specialist, stronghold defense core

profile.background: Terry Musa was born in Africa into a military family and received rigorous disciplinary training from childhood. He graduated with distinction from a Military Engineering Academy before joining an international counter-terrorism bomb disposal unit. Over more than a decade of EOD service, he处理 over 300 explosive devices of various types, accumulating unparalleled expertise in defensive fortification construction and explosive ordnance disposal. His calm judgment and engineering intuition earned him the highest reputation in the field.
profile.desertSpring: During a high-risk urban bomb disposal operation, Terry's squad was ambushed and communications were severed. Africa Division under the codename "Shepherd" — symbolizing the guardian who protects the flock from external threats. He integrated defensive engineering principles into tactical operations, developing a defense system centered on acoustic sensing and trap deployment, becoming the team's most formidable defensive line.
profile.skillsIntro: Shepherd's combat framework is built around defensive fortification construction and trap control, emphasizing area denial and stronghold retention.

profile.background: Rashid Rahal was born into a family of mechanical artisans in the Ahsarah region, displaying extraordinary aptitude for electronics and machinery from childhood. profile.skillsIntro: Bit's combat framework is built around autonomous combat pets and mechanical traps, emphasizing reconnaissance锁定 and area control capability.

equipment.desc: Deploys an autonomous combat spider robot capable of executing reconnaissance patrols,锁定 and marking enemy personnel, and close-range assault. The spider robot possesses autonomous AI that灵活 adjusts its action策略 based on battlefield形势, serving as Bit's core combat companion.

profile.engagement: Engagement sequence: deploy Blaze Spider to reconnoiter and锁定 enemies → Electromagnetic Traps封锁 critical passages → Dragon's Breath清除 targets behind cover → Spider Robot配合 close-quarters收割.

wulululu.name: David Ferrier
wulululu.bio: Oceania engineering operator, mobile fortress with攻守兼备 capability

profile.background: David Ferrier was born in Australia into a mining family; he possesses a imposing physique and composed temperament. Developing a deep passion for mechanical engineering from childhood, he graduated with distinction from a Military Engineering Academy and joined the Australian Army Engineering Corps. Over more than a decade of military service, he参与 in multiple major construction projects and battlefield fortification missions, accumulating extensive实战 experience and engineering development expertise. His towering, rugged build earned him the affectionate nickname "Mobile Fortress" among his comrades.
profile.desertSpring: During an overseas peacekeeping operation, David's squad was围困 by militants.利用 his随身携带 engineering materials, he constructed an improvised defensive fortification in极短 time and used自制巡航 missiles to精确 strike enemy火力点, successfully opening an evacuation corridor for the squad. The action demonstrated his卓越攻守兼备 capability and drew the attention of G.T.I. leadership.
profile.joingti: When G.T.I. was构建 its Oceania Division engineering力量, it recognized David's双重 talent in defensive fortification construction and long-range precision strike.
